description: END18, synthetic from the three era-1 orders the spec quotes (2026-10-08T14:38:37Z, 2026-10-09T09:17:28Z, 2026-10-09T14:31:32Z): the call window reads gone with the Leave button armed and healthy, and the rescue's re-asserted healthy Leave arrives 0.3, 1.0 and 1.8 s later. The era-1 engine never received that reading (armIfNeeded emitted nothing on a healthy button) and ended each recording 2 s in. Process audio is absent here, the case END14's veto cannot cover. Each hold reverts; the call never ends.
